s.d: φόβητρον (LTr., WH, -θρον), -ου, τό (φοβέω), [in LXX: [[isaiah 19 17|Isa.19:17]] (חָגָא) * ;] that which causes fright, a terror: pl. (as always, exc.Isa, l.with), [[luke 21 11|Luk.21:11]] (Hipp., Plat.).† (AS)

φόβος, -ου, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for יִרְאָה, also for פַּחַד, אֵימָה, etc. ;] 1. in Hom., flight. 2. That which causes flight, fear, dread, terror: [[luke 1 12|Luk.1:12]], [[acts 5 5|Act.5:5]], [[1-timothy 5 20|1Ti.5:20.]] [[1-john 4 18|1Jn.4:18]], al.; cogn. accusative, φοβεῖσθαι φ., [[mark 4 41|Mrk.4:41]], [[luke 2 9|Luk.2:9]]; with genitive obj., [[john 7 13|Jhn.7:13 19:33 20:19]], [[hebrews 2 5|Heb.2:5]], [[1-peter 3 14|1Pe.3:14]] (but cf. ICC, in l);ἀπὸ (τοῦ) φ., [[matthew 14 26|Mat.14:26]], [[luke 21 26|Luk.21:26]]; εἰς φ., [[romans 8 15|Rom.8:15;]] μετὰ φόβου, [[matthew 28 8|Mat.28:8;]] φ. καὶ τρόμος (Lft., Notes, 172), [[1-corinthians 2 3|1Co.2:3]], [[2-corinthians 7 15|2Co.7:15]], [[ephesians 6 5|Eph.6:5]], [[philippians 2 12|Php.2:12]]; by meton., of that which causes fear, [[romans 13 3|Rom.13:3;]] of reverential fear, [[romans 13 7|Rom.13:7]], [[1-peter 1 17|1Pe.1:17 2:18 3:2 3:15]]; τ. κυρίου, [[acts 9 31|Act.9:31]], [[2-corinthians 5 11|2Co.5:11]] (see Field, Notes, 183); Χριστοῦ, [[ephesians 5 21|Eph.5:21;]] θεοῦ, [[romans 3 18|Rom.3:18]], [[2-corinthians 7 1|2Co.7:1]] SYN.: see: δειλία (and of. DCG, i, 381) (AS)
φοίβη, -ης, ἡ Phæbe, a deaconess of Cenchræa: [[romans 16 1|Rom.16:1.]]† (AS)
φοινίκη, -ης, ἡ Phænicia: [[acts 11 19|Act.11:19 15:3 21:2]] (see DB, iii, 856b, 857a.n).† (AS)

Φοῖνιξ (on the accent, see Bl., § 4, 2; WM, § 6, lc), -ικος, ὁ, [in LXX for תָּמָר תִּמֹּר ;] the date palm, palm: τὰ βαΐα τῶν φ., [[john 12 13|Jhn.12:13;]] of palm branches, φοίνικες (as Arist., 2Ma.10:7, al.), [[revelation 7 9|Rev.7:9]].† (AS)
φοῖνιξ, -ικος, ο, ἡ Phænix, a city of Crete: [[acts 27 12|Act.27:12.]]† (AS)

φονεύς, -έως, ὁ (φόνος) [in LXX: Wis.12:5 * ;] a murderer: [[matthew 22 7|Mat.22:7]] [[acts 7 52|Act.7:52 28:4]], [[1-peter 4 15|1Pe.4:15]], [[revelation 21 8|Rev.21:8 22:15]]; ἀνὴρ φ., [[acts 3 14|Act.3:14.]]† SYN.: ἀνθρωποκτόνος (AS)

φονεύω (φονεύς), [in LXX chiefly for רָצַח ;] to kill, murder. absol., [[matthew 5 21|Mat.5:21]], [[james 4 2|Jas.4:2]]; μὴ (οὐ) φονεύσῃς (-εις), [[matthew 5 21|Mat.5:21 19:18]], [[mark 10 19|Mrk.10:19]], [[luke 18 20|Luk.18:20]], [[romans 13 9|Rom.13:9]], [[james 2 11|Jas.2:11]] (all from [[exodus 20 13|Exo.20:13-14]]); with accusative, [[matthew 23 31|Mat.23:31, 35]], [[james 5 6|Jas.5:6]].† (AS)

φόνος, -ου, ὁ [in LXX for דָּם, פֶּה, etc. ;] murder, slaughter: [[mark 15 7|Mrk.15:7]], [[luke 23 19|Luk.23:19, 25]], [[acts 9 1|Act.9:1]], [[romans 1 29|Rom.1:29]]; φ. μαχαίρης (cf. [[exodus 17 13|Exo.17:13]], al.), [[hebrews 11 37|Heb.11:37]]; pl., [[matthew 15 19|Mat.15:19]], [[mark 7 21|Mrk.7:21]], [[revelation 9 21|Rev.9:21]].† (AS)

φορέω, -ῶ [in LXX: [[proverbs 16 23|Pro.16:23]] (יָסַף hi.), Sir.11:5, al. ;] frequent. of φέρω, denoting repeated or habitual action (cf. Tr., Syn., § lviii), most commonly used of clothing, weapons, etc., to bear constantly, wear: [[matthew 11 8|Mat.11:8]], [[john 19 5|Jhn.19:5]], [[romans 13 4|Rom.13:4]], [[1-corinthians 15 49|1Co.15:49]], [[james 2 3|Jas.2:3]].† (AS)
φόρον, -ου, τό (Lat. forum): Ἀππίου Φ., see: Ἄππιος (AS)

φόρος, .-ου, ὁ (φέρω), [in LXX chiefly for מַס, also for מִדָּה, etc. ;] tribute paid by a subject nation (cf. 1Ma.10:33): φ. δοῦναι (1Ma.8:4 1Mac 8:7), [[luke 20 22|Luk.20:22 23:2]]; ἀποδοῦναι, [[romans 13 7|Rom.13:7;]] τελεῖν, [[romans 13 6|Rom.13:6]] (Hdt., al.).† SYN.: κῆνσος, τέλος (which see) (AS)

φορτίζω (φόρτος), [in LXX: [[ezekiel 16 33|Eze.16:33]] (שָׁחַד) * ;] to load: with dupl. accusative, [[luke 11 46|Luk.11:46;]] pass., to be laden: metaphorically (EV, heavy laden), [[matthew 11 28|Mat.11:28.]]† (AS)

φορτίον, -ου, τό (dimin. of φόρτος), [in LXX chiefly for מַשָּׂא ;] a burden, load: of the cargo of a ship (Hdt., al.), [[acts 27 10|Act.27:10;]] metaphorically, [[matthew 11 30|Mat.11:30 23:4]], [[luke 11 46|Luk.11:46]], [[galatians 6 5|Gal.6:5]].† SYN.: βάρος (which see), ὄγκος (AS)
φόρτος, -ου, ὁ (φέρω), a load: esp. of a ship's cargo (Hom., Hdt., and late prose writers), [[acts 27 10|Act.27:10]], Rec.† (AS)
φορτούνατος (Rec. Φουρ-, see Mayser, 116 f.), -ου, ὁ (Lat.) Fortunatus: [[1-corinthians 16 17|1Co.16:17]] (see Lft., Cl. Ro., 1Co., 59).† (AS)
φραγέλλιον, -ου, τό (Lat. flagellum), a scourge: [[john 2 15|Jhn.2:15.]]† (AS)
φραγελλόω, -ῶ (φραγέλλιον, which see), to scourge: with accusative, [[matthew 27 26|Mat.27:26]], [[mark 15 15|Mrk.15:15]] (eccl.).† (AS)

φραγμός, -oῦ, ὁ (φράσσω), [in LXX chiefly for גָּדֵר, גְּדֵרָה, also for גְּדֵרָה, etc. ;] 1. prop., a fencing in (Soph., OT, 1387). 2. = φράγμα, a fence: [[matthew 21 33|Mat.21:33]], [[mark 12 1|Mrk.12:1]], [[luke 14 23|Luk.14:23]]. Metaphorical, μεσότοιχον (which see) τοῦ φ., genitive epexeg., [[ephesians 2 14|Eph.2:14]] (see Ellic., in l).† (AS)

φράζω [in LXX: [[job 6 24|Job.6:24]] (בִּין hi.) [[job 12 8|Job.12:8]] (יָרָה hi.), Dan LXX 2:4 (חָוָה pa.) * ;] to show forth, tell, declare, explain: [[matthew 13 36|Mat.13:36]] (WH, RV, διασάφησον) [[matthew 15 15|Mat.15:15.]]† (AS)

φράσσω [in LXX: [[job 38 8|Job.38:8]] (סָכַךְ hi.), [[hosea 2 6|Hos.2:6]](8) (שׂוּךְ), [[proverbs 21 13|Pro.21:13]] (אָטַם), etc. ;] to fence in, stop, close: στόματα λεόντων, [[hebrews 11 33|Heb.11:33;]] στόμα, metaphorically, [[romans 3 19|Rom.3:19;]] pass., καύχησις, [[2-corinthians 11 10|2Co.11:10.]]† (AS)
φρέαρ, -ατος, τό [in LXX chiefly for בְּאֵר ;] a well: [[luke 14 5|Luk.14:5]], [[song-of-solomon 4 11|Sng.4:11-12]]; φ. τῆς ἀβύσσου, [[revelation 9 1|Rev.9:1-2.]]† (AS)
φρεν-απατάω, -ῶ (φρεναπάτης), to deceive one's mind (Lft., deceive by fancies, see Ga., l.with): with accusative of person(s), [[galatians 6 3|Gal.6:3.]]† (AS)
φρεναπάτης, -ου, ὁ (φρήν, ἀπάτη), a deceiver (B1., deceiver of his own mind, § 28, 5.2, where see ref. to π.): [[titus 1 10|Tit.1:10]] (eccl.).† (AS)

φρήν genitive, φρενός, ἡ, [in LXX most frequently in Pr ([[proverbs 6 32|Pro.6:32]], al.) and chiefly for לֵב; also 3Ma.4:16 3Mac 5:47 ;] chiefly in Hom. and Trag., but also in Plat., al., both sing. and pl.; 1. in physical sense, the parts about the heart, midriff. 2. heart, mind, thought: pl., [[1-corinthians 14 20|1Co.14:20]] (see Edwards, Eng.-Gr. Lex., App., 1).† (AS)

φρίσσω (Att.. -ττω, and so 4Ma.14:9 4Mac 17:7) [in LXX: [[job 4 15|Job.4:15]] ( pi.), etc. ;] 1. to be rough, bristle. 2. to shiver, shudder, tremble, from fear: [[james 2 19|Jas.2:19]] (see Hort, in l).† (AS)

φρονέω, -ῶ (φρήν), [in LXX: [[deuteronomy 32 29|Deu.32:29]], [[zechariah 9 2|Zec.9:2]] (חָכָם), [[psalms 94 8|Psa.94:8]] (שָׂכַל hi.), [[isaiah 44 18|Isa.44:18]] (בִּין) [[isaiah 44 28|Isa.44:28]], [[esther 8 13|Est.8:13]], Wis.1:1 14:30, 1Ma.10:20, 2Ma.9:12; 2Ma.14:8 2Mac 14:26 * ;] 1. to have understanding (Hon., al.). 2. to think, to be minded in a certain way: ὡς νήπιος, [[1-corinthians 13 11|1Co.13:11;]] with accusative (usually neut., adj., or pron., as frequently in cl.), ὃ δεῖ, [[romans 12 3|Rom.12:3;]] ἃ, [[acts 28 22|Act.28:22;]] τοῦτο, [[philippians 3 15|Php.3:15;]] τι ἑτέρως, ib.; οὐδὲν ἄλλο, [[galatians 5 10|Gal.5:10;]] τ. αὐτὸ φ. (Deiss., BS, 256), to be of the same mind, [[2-corinthians 13 11|2Co.13:11]], [[philippians 2 2|Php.2:2 4:2]]; id. before εἰς (ἐν) ἀλλήλους(οις), [[romans 12 16|Rom.12:16 15:5]]; τ. ἓν φ., [[philippians 2 2|Php.2:2]] (Lft., in l); before ὑπέρ, [[philippians 1 7|Php.1:7.]] 3. to have in mind, be mindful of, think of (Hdt., Xen., al.; Es, 1Mac, ll. with): τὰ τ. θεοῦ, opposite to τ. τ. ἀνθρώπων, [[matthew 16 23|Mat.16:23]], [[mark 8 33|Mrk.8:33]]; τὰ τ. σαρκός, opposite to τ. τ. πνεύρατος, [[romans 8 5|Rom.8:5;]] τ. ἐπίγεια, [[philippians 3 19|Php.3:19;]] τὰ ἄνω, opposite to τ. ἐπὶ τ. γῆς, [[colossians 3 2|Col.3:2;]] τοῦτο φρονεῖτε (RV, have this mind in you), [[philippians 2 5|Php.2:5;]] ὑψηλά, [[romans 12 16|Rom.12:16;]] φ. ἡμέραν (to observe a day), [[romans 14 6|Rom.14:6;]] before ὑπέρ, [[philippians 4 10|Php.4:10]] (cf. κατα-, παρα-, περι-, ὑπερ-φρσνέω).† (AS)
φρόνημα, -τος, τό (φρονέω), [in LXX: 2Ma.7:21 2Mac 13:9 * ;] that which is in the mind (the content of φρονεῖν, ICC, Ro., 88), the thought: [[romans 8 6|Rom.8:6-7, 27]].† (AS)

φρόνησις, -εως, ἡ (φρονέω), [in LXX for בִּינָה, תָּבוּן, חׇכְמָה, etc. ;] understanding, practical wisdom, prudence: [[luke 1 17|Luk.1:17]], [[ephesians 1 8|Eph.1:8]].† SYN.: see: σοφία, and cf. Lft., Notes, 317 (AS)

φρόνιμος, -ον (φρονέω), [in LXX for בִּין, חָכָם etc. ;] practically wise, sensible, prudent: [[matthew 10 16|Mat.10:16 24:45]], [[luke 12 42|Luk.12:42]], [[1-corinthians 10 15|1Co.10:15]]; opposite to μωρός, [[matthew 7 24|Mat.7:24 25:2, 4 25:8-9]], [[1-corinthians 4 10|1Co.4:10]]; to ἄφρων, [[2-corinthians 11 19|2Co.11:19;]] φ. παρ᾽ ἑαυτῷ (EV, wise in one's own conceit), [[romans 11 25|Rom.11:25 12:16]] (cf. [[proverbs 3 7|Pro.3:7]]); compar., -ώτερος, [[luke 16 8|Luk.16:8.]]† SYN.: see: σοψός (AS)
φρονίμως adv., sensibly, prudently: [[luke 16 8|Luk.16:8.]]† (AS)

φροντίζω (φροντίς, thought), [in LXX: [[1-samuel 9 5|1Ki.9:5]] (דָּאַג), [[psalms 40 17|Psa.40:17]] (חָשַׁב), al. ;] to give heed, take thought (in cl. usually absol., with accusative, with genitive), with inf., [[titus 3 8|Tit.3:8]] (see Bl., § 69, 4; M, Pr., 206 f.).† (AS)

φρουρέω, -ῶ (φρουρός, a guard), [in LXX: I [[esther 4 56|Est.4:56]], Jdth.3:6, Wis.17:16, 1Ma.11:3 * ;] to guard, keep under guard, protect or keep by guarding: [[2-corinthians 11 32|2Co.11:32;]] metaphorically, [[galatians 3 23|Gal.3:23]], [[philippians 4 7|Php.4:7]], [[1-peter 1 5|1Pe.1:5]].† (AS)

φρυάσσω (so Ps, l.with, NT; elsewhere depon., φρυάσσομαι, Att.. -ττ-), [in LXX: [[psalms 2 1|Psa.2:1]] (רָגַשׁ), 2Ma.7:34 R, 3Ma.2:2 * ;] prop., of horses, to neigh, whinny and prance (Plut., al.). Metaphorical, to be wanton, insolent: [[acts 4 25|Act.4:25]] (LXX).† (AS)
φρύγανον, -ου, τό (φρύγω, to parch), [in LXX chiefly for קַשׁ, also for חָרוּל, etc. ;] a dry stick: pl., brushwood: [[acts 28 3|Act.28:3.]]† (AS)

φρυγία, -ας, ἡ (prop., the adj., Φρυγίος, -α, -ον; sc. γῆ, χώρα), Phrygia, a region of Asia Minor: [[acts 2 10|Act.2:10;]] Φ. καὶ Γαλατικὴ χώρα (Γ. χ. κ. Φ.), [[acts 16 6|Act.16:6 18:23]] (on these phrases see DB, i, 89 f.; CGT, Gal., xxii f.).† (AS)
φύγελος (Rec. -λλος), -ου, ὁ Phygelus: [[2-timothy 1 15|2Ti.1:15.]]† (AS)
φυγή, -ῆς, ἡ (φεύγω), [in LXX chiefly for מָנוֹס and cogn. forms ;] flight: [[matthew 24 20|Mat.24:20.]]† (AS)

φυλακή, -ῆς, ἡ (φυλάσσω) [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁמֶרֶת and cogn. forms, also for כֶּלֶא etc. ;] (a) actively, a guarding, guard, watch (Hom., Plat., Xen., al.): cogn. accusative, φυλάσσειν φυλακάς, to keep watch, [[luke 2 8|Luk.2:8;]] (b) of those who keep watch (as also Lat. custodia), a guard; pl., sentinels, a guard (Hom., al.): [[acts 12 10|Act.12:10;]] (with) of the place where persons are kept under guard, a prison (Hdt., Thuc., al.): [[matthew 14 10|Mat.14:10]], [[mark 6 17|Mrk.6:17]], [[luke 3 20|Luk.3:20]], [[acts 5 19|Act.5:19]], [[2-corinthians 6 5|2Co.6:5]], [[1-peter 3 19|1Pe.3:19]], [[revelation 18 2|Rev.18:2]], al.; (d) of the time during which guard was kept by night (Lest. vigilia; Anthol.), a watch: [[matthew 14 25|Mat.14:25 24:43]], [[mark 6 48|Mrk.6:48]], [[luke 12 38|Luk.12:38]] (AS)

φυλακή, -ῆς, ἡ (φυλάσσω) [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁמֶרֶת and cogn. forms, also for כֶּלֶא etc. ;] (a) actively, a guarding, guard, watch (Hom., Plat., Xen., al.): cogn. accusative, φυλάσσειν φυλακάς, to keep watch, [[luke 2 8|Luk.2:8;]] (b) of those who keep watch (as also Lat. custodia), a guard; pl., sentinels, a guard (Hom., al.): [[acts 12 10|Act.12:10;]] (with) of the place where persons are kept under guard, a prison (Hdt., Thuc., al.): [[matthew 14 10|Mat.14:10]], [[mark 6 17|Mrk.6:17]], [[luke 3 20|Luk.3:20]], [[acts 5 19|Act.5:19]], [[2-corinthians 6 5|2Co.6:5]], [[1-peter 3 19|1Pe.3:19]], [[revelation 18 2|Rev.18:2]], al.; (d) of the time during which guard was kept by night (Lest. vigilia; Anthol.), a watch: [[matthew 14 25|Mat.14:25 24:43]], [[mark 6 48|Mrk.6:48]], [[luke 12 38|Luk.12:38]] (AS)
φυλακίζω [in LXX: Wis.18:4 * ;] to imprison: [[acts 22 19|Act.22:19.]]† (AS)

φυλακτήριον, -ου, τό 1. an outpost, fortification (Thuc., al.). 2. a safeguard (Plat.). 3. an amulet (Plut., al.); in NT for the Talmudic תְּפִלִּין, a prayer fillet, a phylactery, a small strip of parchment on which portions of the law were written and worn on the forehead and next the heart (cf. [[exodus 13 16|Exo.13:16]]): [[matthew 23 5|Mat.23:5]].† (AS)
φύλαξ, -ακος, ὁ (φυλάσσω), [in LXX for שָׁמַר, צוּר ;] a guard, keeper: [[acts 5 23|Act.5:23 12:6, 19]].† (AS)

φυλάσσω [in LXX chiefly and very frequently for שָׁמַר, also for נָצַר, etc. ;] to guard, watch; (a) to guard or watch: with cogn. accusative, φυλακάς, [[luke 2 8|Luk.2:8;]] with accusative of person(s), [[acts 12 4|Act.12:4 28:16]]; pass., [[luke 8 29|Luk.8:29]], [[acts 23 35|Act.23:35]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[acts 22 20|Act.22:20;]] (b) to guard or protect: with accusative, [[luke 11 21|Luk.11:21]], [[john 12 25|Jhn.12:25 17:12]], [[2-thessalonians 3 3|2Th.3:3]], [[1-timothy 6 20|1Ti.6:20]], [[2-timothy 1 12|2Ti.1:12 1:14]], [[2-peter 2 5|2Pe.2:5]]; ἑαυτὸν ἀπό, [[1-john 5 21|1Jn.5:21]] (Westc., in l); metaphorically of law, precept, etc., to keep, preserve, observe: [[matthew 19 20|Mat.19:20]], [[luke 11 28|Luk.11:28 18:21]], [[john 12 47|Jhn.12:47]], [[acts 7 53|Act.7:53 16:4 21:24]], [[romans 2 26|Rom.2:26]], [[galatians 6 13|Gal.6:13]], [[1-timothy 5 21|1Ti.5:21]]. Mid., to be on one's guard (against), keep oneself from, beware of: with accusative, [[acts 21 25|Act.21:25]], [[2-timothy 4 15|2Ti.4:15]]; before ἀπό., [[luke 12 15|Luk.12:15;]] ἵνα μή, [[2-peter 3 17|2Pe.3:17;]] as in LXX ([[exodus 12 17|Exo.12:17]], [[leviticus 18 4|Lev.18:4]], al.), of laws, etc., to keep, observe: ταῦτα πάντα, [[mark 10 20|Mrk.10:20]] (cf. δια-φυάσσω).† SYN.: τηρέω, q.v (AS)

φυλάσσω [in LXX chiefly and very frequently for שָׁמַר, also for נָצַר, etc. ;] to guard, watch; (a) to guard or watch: with cogn. accusative, φυλακάς, [[luke 2 8|Luk.2:8;]] with accusative of person(s), [[acts 12 4|Act.12:4 28:16]]; pass., [[luke 8 29|Luk.8:29]], [[acts 23 35|Act.23:35]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[acts 22 20|Act.22:20;]] (b) to guard or protect: with accusative, [[luke 11 21|Luk.11:21]], [[john 12 25|Jhn.12:25 17:12]], [[2-thessalonians 3 3|2Th.3:3]], [[1-timothy 6 20|1Ti.6:20]], [[2-timothy 1 12|2Ti.1:12 1:14]], [[2-peter 2 5|2Pe.2:5]]; ἑαυτὸν ἀπό, [[1-john 5 21|1Jn.5:21]] (Westc., in l); metaphorically of law, precept, etc., to keep, preserve, observe: [[matthew 19 20|Mat.19:20]], [[luke 11 28|Luk.11:28 18:21]], [[john 12 47|Jhn.12:47]], [[acts 7 53|Act.7:53 16:4 21:24]], [[romans 2 26|Rom.2:26]], [[galatians 6 13|Gal.6:13]], [[1-timothy 5 21|1Ti.5:21]]. Mid., to be on one's guard (against), keep oneself from, beware of: with accusative, [[acts 21 25|Act.21:25]], [[2-timothy 4 15|2Ti.4:15]]; before ἀπό., [[luke 12 15|Luk.12:15;]] ἵνα μή, [[2-peter 3 17|2Pe.3:17;]] as in LXX ([[exodus 12 17|Exo.12:17]], [[leviticus 18 4|Lev.18:4]], al.), of laws, etc., to keep, observe: ταῦτα πάντα, [[mark 10 20|Mrk.10:20]] (cf. δια-φυάσσω).† SYN.: τηρέω, q.v (AS)

φυλάσσω [in LXX chiefly and very frequently for שָׁמַר, also for נָצַר, etc. ;] to guard, watch; (a) to guard or watch: with cogn. accusative, φυλακάς, [[luke 2 8|Luk.2:8;]] with accusative of person(s), [[acts 12 4|Act.12:4 28:16]]; pass., [[luke 8 29|Luk.8:29]], [[acts 23 35|Act.23:35]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[acts 22 20|Act.22:20;]] (b) to guard or protect: with accusative, [[luke 11 21|Luk.11:21]], [[john 12 25|Jhn.12:25 17:12]], [[2-thessalonians 3 3|2Th.3:3]], [[1-timothy 6 20|1Ti.6:20]], [[2-timothy 1 12|2Ti.1:12 1:14]], [[2-peter 2 5|2Pe.2:5]]; ἑαυτὸν ἀπό, [[1-john 5 21|1Jn.5:21]] (Westc., in l); metaphorically of law, precept, etc., to keep, preserve, observe: [[matthew 19 20|Mat.19:20]], [[luke 11 28|Luk.11:28 18:21]], [[john 12 47|Jhn.12:47]], [[acts 7 53|Act.7:53 16:4 21:24]], [[romans 2 26|Rom.2:26]], [[galatians 6 13|Gal.6:13]], [[1-timothy 5 21|1Ti.5:21]]. Mid., to be on one's guard (against), keep oneself from, beware of: with accusative, [[acts 21 25|Act.21:25]], [[2-timothy 4 15|2Ti.4:15]]; before ἀπό., [[luke 12 15|Luk.12:15;]] ἵνα μή, [[2-peter 3 17|2Pe.3:17;]] as in LXX ([[exodus 12 17|Exo.12:17]], [[leviticus 18 4|Lev.18:4]], al.), of laws, etc., to keep, observe: ταῦτα πάντα, [[mark 10 20|Mrk.10:20]] (cf. δια-φυάσσω).† SYN.: τηρέω, q.v (AS)

φυλή, ῆς, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for; מַטֶּה, also for שֵׁבֶט, מִשְׁפָּחָה, etc. ;] a body of men united by kinship or habitation, a clan or tribe: of the tribes of Israel, [[matthew 19 28|Mat.19:28]], [[luke 2 36|Luk.2:36 22:30]], [[acts 13 21|Act.13:21]], [[romans 11 1|Rom.11:1]], [[philippians 3 5|Php.3:5]], [[hebrews 7 13|Heb.7:13-14]], [[james 1 1|Jas.1:1]], [[revelation 5 5|Rev.5:5 7:4-8 21:12]]; of the tribes of the earth, the peoples and nations, [[matthew 24 30|Mat.24:30]], [[revelation 1 7|Rev.1:7 5:9 7:9 11:9 13:7 14:6]].† (AS)
φύλλον, -ου, τό [in LXX chiefly for עָלֶה ;] a leaf: [[matthew 21 19|Mat.21:19 24:32]], [[mark 11 13|Mrk.11:13 13:28]], [[revelation 22 2|Rev.22:2]].† (AS)

φύραμα, -τος, τό (φυράω, to mix), [in LXX: [[exodus 8 3|Exo.8:3]] ([[exodus 7 28|Exo.7:28]]) [[exodus 12 34|Exo.12:34]] (מִשְׁאֶרֶת), מִשְׁאֶרֶת), [[numbers 15 20|Num.15:20-21]] (עֲרִיסָה) * ;] that which is mixed or kneaded, a lump: of dough, [[romans 11 16|Rom.11:16]], [[1-corinthians 5 6|1Co.5:6-7]], [[galatians 5 9|Gal.5:9]]; of clay, [[romans 9 21|Rom.9:21.]]† (AS)

φυσικός, -ή, -όν (ψύσις), natural (a) produced by nature, innate (Xen., Arist., al.); (b) according to nature (Arist., Diod., al.): opposite to παρὰ φύσιν, [[romans 1 26|Rom.1:26-27;]] (with) governed by mere natural instinct (of. Plut., Mor., 706 A): ζῷα γεγεννημένα φ. (RV, born mere animals; Mayor, born creatures of instinct; ICC, animals born of mere nature), [[2-peter 2 12|2Pe.2:12]],† (AS)
φυσικῶς adv., naturally, by nature: Ju 10.† (AS)

φυσιόω, -ῶ (φῦσα, bellows), = cl. φυσάω, to puff or blow up, inflate. Metaphorical, to puff up, make proud: [[1-corinthians 8 1|1Co.8:1.]] Pass., to be puffed up with pride: [[1-corinthians 4 18|1Co.4:18-19 5:2 13:4]]; before ὑπό, [[colossians 2 18|Col.2:18;]] before ὑπὲρ . . . κατά, [[1-corinthians 4 6|1Co.4:6]] (on the form of the subjc., see M, Pr., 54; Bl., § 22, 3).† (AS)

φύσις, -εως, ἡ (φύω) [in LXX: Wis.7:20 13:1 19:20 אΑ, 3Ma.3:29, 4Ma.1:20 4Mac 5:7-8 4Mac 5:25 4Mac 13:27 4Mac 15:13 4Mac 15:25 4Mac 16:3 * ;] nature, i.e., (a) the nature (natural powers or constitution) of a person or thing: [[james 3 7|Jas.3:7]], [[2-peter 1 4|2Pe.1:4]]; τέκνα φυσει ὀργῆς, [[ephesians 2 3|Eph.2:3;]] (b) origin, birth (Soph., Xen., al.): [[romans 2 27|Rom.2:27]], [[galatians 2 15|Gal.2:15]]; (with) nature, i.e. the regular order or law of nature: [[1-corinthians 11 14|1Co.11:14;]] dative, φύσει adverbially, by nature, [[romans 2 14|Rom.2:14]], [[galatians 4 8|Gal.4:8]]; παρὰ φύσιν, against nature, [[romans 1 26|Rom.1:26 11:24]]; καρὰ φ., according to nature, naturally, [[romans 11 21|Rom.11:21, 24]].† (AS)
φυσίωσις, -εως, ἡ (φυσιόω), a puffing up, swelling with pride: pl., [[2-corinthians 12 20|2Co.12:20.]]† (AS)

φυτεία, -ας, ἡ (φυτεύω), [in LXX: [[2-kings 19 29|4Ki.19:29]] (נָטַע), [[micah 1 6|Mic.1:6]], [[ezekiel 17 7|Eze.17:7]] (מַטָּע) * ;] 1. a planting (Xen., al.; LXX). 2. = φύτευμα, that which is planted, a plant (Inscr.): [[matthew 15 13|Mat.15:13.]]† (AS)

φυτεύω (φυτόν, a plant, φύω), [in LXX chiefly for נָטַע, also for שָׁתַל, etc. ;] to plant: [[luke 17 28|Luk.17:28]], [[1-corinthians 3 6|1Co.3:6-8]]; with accusative, φυτείαν, [[matthew 15 13|Mat.15:13;]] ἀμπελῶνα, [[matthew 21 33|Mat.21:33]], [[mark 12 1|Mrk.12:1]], [[luke 20 9|Luk.20:9]], [[1-corinthians 9 7|1Co.9:7]]; pass., before ἐν, [[luke 13 6|Luk.13:6 17:6]].† (AS)

φύω [in LXX: [[proverbs 26 9|Pro.26:9]], [[ezekiel 37 8|Eze.37:8]] (עָלָה), etc. ;] 1. trans., to bring forth, produce (of men, to beget); pass., to spring up, grow: [[luke 8 6|Luk.8:6]], 8. 2. Intrans., in 2 aor., pf., plpf., and rarely in present (see LS, see word, A, II.), to spring up: [[hebrews 12 15|Heb.12:15.]]† (AS)
φωλεός, -οῦ ὁ a hole, den, lair: [[matthew 8 20|Mat.8:20]], [[luke 9 58|Luk.9:58]].† (AS)

φωνέω, -ῶ (φωνή), [in LXX for קָרָא ([[jeremiah 17 11|Jer.17:11]], al.), etc. ;] I. Intrans. 1. Of persons, to call out, cry out, speak aloud: [[luke 8 8|Luk.8:8;]] φωνῇ μεγάλῃ, [[mark 1 26|Mrk.1:26]], [[acts 16 28|Act.16:28]]; ἐφώνησε (φωνῇ μεγάλῇ) λέγων, [[luke 8 54|Luk.8:54]], [[revelation 14 18|Rev.14:18]]; φωνήσαντες ἐπύθοντο, [[acts 10 18|Act.10:18.]] 2. Of the cries of animals (rarely in cl.; [[isaiah 38 14|Isa.38:14]], Je, l.with): of a cock, to crow, [[matthew 26 34|Mat.26:34]], [[mark 14 30|Mrk.14:30]], [[luke 22 3|Luk.22:3]], [[john 13 38|Jhn.13:38 18:27]]. II. Trans. (in cl. chiefly poët.), with accusative of person(s), to call, summon, invite: [[matthew 20 32|Mat.20:32 27:47]], [[mark 9 35|Mrk.9:35 10:49 15:35]], [[luke 14 12|Luk.14:12 16:2 19:15]], [[john 1 49|Jhn.1:49 2:9 4:16 10:3 11:28 12:17 18:33]], [[acts 9 41|Act.9:41 10:7]]; to address, call by name (Soph.), [[john 13 13|Jhn.13:13]] (cf. ἀνα-, ἐπι-, προσ-, συν-φωνέω).† (AS)

φωνή, -ῆς, ἡ, [in LXX chiefly and very frequently for קוֹל ;] a voice; (a) prop., of persons, [[matthew 2 18|Mat.2:18]] (LXX), al.; φ. αἴρειν (ἐπαίρειν), [[luke 17 13|Luk.17:13]], [[acts 2 14|Act.2:14]], al.; φ. μεγάλῃ εἰπεῖν (λέγειν, φωνεῖν, etc.), [[luke 8 28|Luk.8:28]], [[acts 7 57|Act.7:57]], [[revelation 5 12|Rev.5:12]], al.; γίνεται (ἔρχεται) φ. ἐκ τ. οὐρανῶν (ἐξ οὐρανοῦ), [[mark 1 11|Mrk.1:11]], [[luke 3 22|Luk.3:22]], [[john 12 28|Jhn.12:28]], al. (cf. DCG, ii, 810a; Dalman, Words, 204f.); ἀκούειν φωνήν (-ῆς; see: ἀκούω), [[acts 9 4|Act.9:4]], 7 al.; φ. βοῶντος, [[matthew 3 3|Mat.3:3]], [[mark 1 3|Mrk.1:3]], [[luke 3 4|Luk.3:4]], [[john 1 23|Jhn.1:23]]" (LXX) ; τ. θεοῦ, [[john 5 37|Jhn.5:37]], [[hebrews 3 7|Heb.3:7]], al. By meton., (α) of the speaker, βλέπειν τὴν φ., [[revelation 1 12|Rev.1:12;]] (β) speech, language ( [[genesis 11 1|Gen.11:1]], 4Ma.12:7, al.): [[1-corinthians 14 10|1Co.14:10]]; (b) of inanimate things: [[matthew 24 31|Mat.24:31]], [[john 3 8|Jhn.3:8]], [[acts 2 6|Act.2:6]], [[revelation 1 15|Rev.1:15]]b 9:9 14:2, al. (cf. Tr., Syn., §lxxxix). (AS)

φωνή, -ῆς, ἡ, [in LXX chiefly and very frequently for קוֹל ;] a voice; (a) prop., of persons, [[matthew 2 18|Mat.2:18]] (LXX), al.; φ. αἴρειν (ἐπαίρειν), [[luke 17 13|Luk.17:13]], [[acts 2 14|Act.2:14]], al.; φ. μεγάλῃ εἰπεῖν (λέγειν, φωνεῖν, etc.), [[luke 8 28|Luk.8:28]], [[acts 7 57|Act.7:57]], [[revelation 5 12|Rev.5:12]], al.; γίνεται (ἔρχεται) φ. ἐκ τ. οὐρανῶν (ἐξ οὐρανοῦ), [[mark 1 11|Mrk.1:11]], [[luke 3 22|Luk.3:22]], [[john 12 28|Jhn.12:28]], al. (cf. DCG, ii, 810a; Dalman, Words, 204f.); ἀκούειν φωνήν (-ῆς; see: ἀκούω), [[acts 9 4|Act.9:4]], 7 al.; φ. βοῶντος, [[matthew 3 3|Mat.3:3]], [[mark 1 3|Mrk.1:3]], [[luke 3 4|Luk.3:4]], [[john 1 23|Jhn.1:23]]" (LXX) ; τ. θεοῦ, [[john 5 37|Jhn.5:37]], [[hebrews 3 7|Heb.3:7]], al. By meton., (α) of the speaker, βλέπειν τὴν φ., [[revelation 1 12|Rev.1:12;]] (β) speech, language ( [[genesis 11 1|Gen.11:1]], 4Ma.12:7, al.): [[1-corinthians 14 10|1Co.14:10]]; (b) of inanimate things: [[matthew 24 31|Mat.24:31]], [[john 3 8|Jhn.3:8]], [[acts 2 6|Act.2:6]], [[revelation 1 15|Rev.1:15]]b 9:9 14:2, al. (cf. Tr., Syn., §lxxxix). (AS)

φῶς (Att.. contr. from φάος; φάω), genitive, φωτός, τό, [in LXX chiefly for אוֹר ;] light (opposite to τὸ σκότος, ἡ σκοτία): [[matthew 17 2|Mat.17:2]], 5, [[john 11 9|Jhn.11:9-10]], [[2-corinthians 4 6|2Co.4:6]]; ἡλίου, [[revelation 22 5|Rev.22:5;]] of a lamp, [[luke 8 16|Luk.8:16 11:33]], [[john 5 35|Jhn.5:35]], [[revelation 18 23|Rev.18:23]]; of a supernatural heavenly light, [[acts 9 3|Act.9:3 12:7 22:6, 9 22:11 26:13]]; hence, ἄγγελος φωτός, [[2-corinthians 11 14|2Co.11:14;]] ὁ κλήρος τ. ἁγίων ἐν τ. φ., [[colossians 1 12|Col.1:12;]] of the divine glory, [[revelation 21 24|Rev.21:24;]] by meton., of that which gives light: of fire, [[mark 14 54|Mrk.14:54]], [[luke 22 56|Luk.22:56]] (cl.; 1Ma.12:29; cf. DCG, i, 595; pl., of a lamp or torch, [[acts 16 29|Act.16:29;]] of heavenly bodies, [[james 1 17|Jas.1:17.]] Metaphorical, (a) of God: [[1-john 1 5|1Jn.1:5]] [[john 1 7|Jn 1:7]]; φῶς οἰκῶν ἀπρόσιτον, [[1-timothy 6 16|1Ti.6:16;]] (b) of spiritual truth and its effects on the lives of men: [[matthew 4 16|Mat.4:16 5:16]], [[john 1 4|Jhn.1:4-5 3:19-21]], [[acts 26 18|Act.26:18, 23]], [[2-corinthians 6 14|2Co.6:14]], [[ephesians 5 13|Eph.5:13]], [[1-peter 2 9|1Pe.2:9]], [[1-john 2 8|1Jn.2:8]]; τ. φ. τ. ζωῆς, [[john 8 12|Jhn.8:12;]] τ. ὅπλα τοῦ φ., [[romans 13 12|Rom.13:12;]] καρπὸς τοῦ φ., [[ephesians 5 9|Eph.5:9;]] έν τ. φ. περιπατεῖν (εἶναι, μένειν), [[1-john 1 7|1Jn.1:7]] [[john 2 9|Jn 2:9-10]]; υἱοὶ (τέκνα) τοῦ φ., [[luke 16 8|Luk.16:8]], [[john 12 36|Jhn.12:36]], [[ephesians 5 8|Eph.5:8]], [[1-thessalonians 5 5|1Th.5:5]]; by meton., of one from whom truth shines forth: [[acts 13 47|Act.13:47]] (LXX), [[romans 2 19|Rom.2:19;]] esp. of Christ, [[luke 2 32|Luk.2:32]], [[john 1 7|Jhn.1:7-8 12:35-36, 46]]; τ. φ. τ. κόσμου, [[john 8 12|Jhn.8:12 9:5]];τ. φ. τ. ἀληθινόν, [[john 1 9|Jhn.1:9;]] of Christians, [[matthew 5 14|Mat.5:14]], [[ephesians 5 8|Eph.5:8]]; (with) of the spiritual under­standing: τ. φ. τὸ ἐν σοί, [[matthew 6 23|Mat.6:23]], [[luke 11 35|Luk.11:35]]; (d) adverbially, of that which is open to view (opposite to ἐν τ. σκοτίᾳ): ἐν τ. φ., [[matthew 10 27|Mat.10:27]], [[luke 12 3|Luk.12:3]].† SYN.: see: φέγγος (AS)

φωστήρ, -ῆρος, ὁ (φῶς), [in LXX: [[genesis 1 14|Gen.1:14, 16]] (מָאוֹר), Dan LXX 12:3 (זֹהַר), I [[esther 8 79|Est.8:79]], Wis.13:2, Sir.43:7 * ;] a luminary, light: [[philippians 2 15|Php.2:15]], [[revelation 21 11|Rev.21:11]].† SYN.: φέγγος, φῶς (AS)

φωσ-φόρος, -ον (φῶς, φέρω), light-bringing; as subst., ὁ φ., the morning star (Plat., al.; cf. ἐωσφόρος, [[isaiah 14 12|Isa.14:12]], [[job 3 9|Job.3:9]], [[psalms 110 3|Psa.110:3]]): metaphorically, [[2-peter 1 19|2Pe.1:19]] (see Mayor, in l).† (AS)

φωτεινός (WH, φωτινός), ή, όν (φῶς), [in LXX: Sir.17:31 23:19 * ;] bright, light: νεφέλη, [[matthew 17 5|Mat.17:5;]] opposite to σκοτεινός, [[matthew 6 22|Mat.6:22]], [[luke 11 34|Luk.11:34, 36]].† (AS)

φωτίζω (φῶς) [in LXX for אוֹר hi, יָרָה hi., etc. ;] 1. intrans., to shine, give light (Arist., Plut., a1.): before ἐπί, [[revelation 22 5|Rev.22:5.]] 2. Trans. (a) to illumine, enlighten (Diod., Plut., al.): with accusative, [[luke 11 36|Luk.11:36]], [[revelation 21 23|Rev.21:23]]; pass., [[revelation 18 1|Rev.18:1.]] Metaphorical, of spiritual enlightenment ([[psalms 119 130|Psa.119:130]], Sir.45:17, al.): [[john 1 9|Jhn.1:9]], [[ephesians 1 18|Eph.1:18 3:9]], R, txt., [[hebrews 6 4|Heb.6:4 10:32]]; (b) to bring to light, make known (Polyb.): [[1-corinthians 4 5|1Co.4:5]], [[ephesians 3 9|Eph.3:9]], R, mg., [[2-timothy 1 10|2Ti.1:10]] (cf. Kennedy, Sources, 107 f.).† (AS)

φωτισμός, -οῦ, ὁ (φωτίζω) [in LXX: [[job 3 9|Job.3:9]], [[psalms 27 1|Psa.27:1 44:3 78:14 139:11]] (אוֹר), [[psalms 89 8|Psa.89:8]] (מָאוֹר) * ;] illumination, light: metaphorically, [[1-corinthians 4 4|1Co.4:4 4:6]].† (AS)

χαίρω [in LXX for שָׂמַח ([[genesis 45 16|Gen.45:16]], al.), גִּיל ([[proverbs 2 14|Pro.2:14]], al.), etc.; inf., as greeting (see infr.), [[isaiah 48 22|Isa.48:22 57:21]] שָׁלוֹם), 1Ma.10:18, 2Ma.1:1 and frequently in these books ;] 1. to rejoice, be glad: [[mark 14 11|Mrk.14:11]], [[luke 15 5|Luk.15:5, 32 19:6, 37 22:5 23:8]], [[john 8 56|Jhn.8:56 20:20]], [[acts 5 41|Act.5:41 8:39 11:23 13:48]], [[2-corinthians 6 10|2Co.6:10 7:7 13:9]], [[philippians 2 17|Php.2:17, 28]], [[colossians 2 5|Col.2:5]], [[1-thessalonians 5 16|1Th.5:16]], [[1-peter 4 13|1Pe.4:13]], 3Jn.3; χ. καὶ ἀγαλλιᾶσθαι, [[matthew 5 12|Mat.5:12;]] κ. σκιρτᾶν, [[luke 6 23|Luk.6:23;]] opposite to κλαίειν, [[romans 12 15|Rom.12:15]], [[1-corinthians 7 30|1Co.7:30]]; to κλαίειν κ. θρηνεῖν [[john 16 20|Jhn.16:20;]] to λύπην ἔχειν, [[john 16 22|Jhn.16:22;]] with cogn. accusative, χ. χαρὰν μεγάλην, [[matthew 2 10|Mat.2:10;]] χαρᾷ χ. (B1., § 38, 3; Dalman, Words, 34 f.), [[john 3 29|Jhn.3:29;]] ἡ χαρὰ ᾗ χαίρομεν, [[1-thessalonians 3 9|1Th.3:9;]] with prep. (Bl., 38, 2), ἐπί, with dative (simple dative in cl.), [[matthew 18 13|Mat.18:13]], [[luke 1 14|Luk.1:14 13:17]], [[acts 15 31|Act.15:31]], [[romans 16 19|Rom.16:19]], [[1-corinthians 13 6|1Co.13:6 16:17]], [[2-corinthians 7 13|2Co.7:13]], [[revelation 11 10|Rev.11:10]]; διά, [[john 3 29|Jhn.3:29 11:15]], [[1-thessalonians 3 9|1Th.3:9]]; ἐν, [[philippians 1 18|Php.1:18;]] ἀπό, [[2-corinthians 2 3|2Co.2:3;]] with accusative (Dem.), [[philippians 2 18|Php.2:18;]] before ὅτι, [[john 14 28|Jhn.14:28]], [[2-corinthians 7 9|2Co.7:9 7:16]], 2Jn.4; ἐν τούτῳ ὅτι, [[luke 10 20|Luk.10:20;]] with dative, [[romans 12 1|Rom.12:1;]] ἐν κυρίῳ, [[philippians 4 10|Php.4:10]] 2. In salutations, imperat., χαῖρε, χαίρετε, (a) at meeting, hail: [[matthew 26 49|Mat.26:49 27:29]], [[mark 15 18|Mrk.15:18]], [[luke 1 28|Luk.1:28]], [[john 19 3|Jhn.19:3]]; pl., [[matthew 28 9|Mat.28:9;]] so χχαίρειν λέγω, to give greeting, II Jn 11; in letters, χαίρειν (sc. λέγει; 81, 1), greeting: [[acts 15 23|Act.15:23 23:26]] [[james 1 1|Jas.1:1]]; (b) at parting, farewell: [[2-corinthians 13 11|2Co.13:11;]] (with) on other occasions, be of good cheer: ἐν κυρίῳ, [[philippians 3 1|Php.3:1 4:4]] (cf. συν-χαίρω).† (AS)
χάλαζα, -ης, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for בָּרָד ;] hail: [[revelation 8 7|Rev.8:7 11:19 16:21]].† (AS)

χαλάω, -ῶ [in LXX: ([[jeremiah 38 6|Jer.38:6]]) (שָׁלַח pi.), etc. ;] (a) to slacken, loosen; (b) to let loose, let go; (with) to lower, let down: with accusative of thing(s), [[mark 2 4|Mrk.2:4]], [[luke 5 4|Luk.5:4-5]], [[acts 9 25|Act.9:25 27:17, 30]]; with accusative of person(s) (cf. Je, l.with), pass., [[2-corinthians 11 33|2Co.11:33.]]† (AS)
Χαλδαῖος, -ου, ὁ a Chaldæan: γῆ Χαλδαίων, [[acts 7 4|Act.7:4.]]† (AS)

χαλεπός, -ή, -όν [in LXX: [[isaiah 18 2|Isa.18:2]] (יָרֵא), Wis.3:19, Sir.3:21, al. ;] hard; (a) hard to do or deal with, difficult; (b) hard to bear, painful, grievous: καιροί, [[2-timothy 3 1|2Ti.3:1;]] (with) of persons, hard to deal with, harsh, fierce, savage: [[matthew 8 28|Mat.8:28.]]† (AS)
χαλιναγωγέω, -ῶ (χαλινός, ἄγω), to lead with a bridle; metaphorically, to bridle, restrain: with accusative, γλῶσσαν, [[james 1 26|Jas.1:26;]] σῶμα, [[james 3 2|Jas.3:2.]]† (AS)
χαλινός, -οῦ, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for מֶתֶג ;] a bridle: [[james 3 3|Jas.3:3]], [[revelation 14 20|Rev.14:20]].† (AS)
χάλκεος, -έα, -εον (-οῦς, -ῆ, -οῦν) (χαλκός), [in LXX chiefly for נְחֹשֶׁת ;] brazen (i.e. of copper): [[revelation 9 20|Rev.9:20.]]† (AS)
χαλκεύς, -έως, ὁ (χαλκός), [in LXX for חָרָשׁ, etc. ;] a worker, in metal, esp. a copper-smith: [[2-timothy 4 14|2Ti.4:14.]]† (AS)
χαλκηδών, -όνος, ὁ chalcedony, "supposed to denote a green silicate of copper found in the mines near Chalcedon " (Swete): [[revelation 21 19|Rev.21:19.]]† (AS)
χαλκίον, -ου, τό (χαλκός), [in LXX: [[job 41 22|Job.41:22]](23) (סִיר), etc. ;] a brazen (copper) vessel: [[mark 7 4|Mrk.7:4.]]† (AS)
χαλκο-λίβανον, -ου, τό chalcolibanus, probably "a mixed metal of great brilliance" (Swete): [[revelation 1 15|Rev.1:15 2:18]] (RV, burnished brass).† (AS)

χαλκός, -oῦ, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for נְחֹשֶׁת ;] copper: [[1-corinthians 13 1|1Co.13:1]], [[revelation 18 12|Rev.18:12]]; by meton., of copper coin, [[matthew 10 9|Mat.10:9]], [[mark 6 8|Mrk.6:8 12:41]].† (AS)
χαμαί adv., on or to the ground: [[john 9 6|Jhn.9:6 18:6]].† (AS)
Χαναάν, ἡ indecl. (Heb. כְּנַעַן), Canaan: [[acts 7 11|Act.7:11;]] γῆ Χ., [[acts 13 19|Act.13:19.]]† (AS)

χάρις, -ιτος, ἡ Abbott-Smith does not include the article here., accusative, χάριν (χάριτα in [[acts 24 27|Act.24:27]], Ju 4; see WH, App., 157), [in LXX chiefly for חֵן ;] 1. objectively, that which causes favourable regard, gracefulness, grace, loveliness of form, graciousness of speech (cl.; [[ecclesiastes 10 12|Ecc.10:12]], Sir.21:16, al.): [[colossians 4 6|Col.4:6]]; λόγοι τ. χάριτος (genitive qual.), [[luke 4 22|Luk.4:22.]] 2. Subjectively, (a) on the part of the giver, grace, graciousness, kindness, goodwill, favour: [[luke 2 52|Luk.2:52]], [[acts 7 10|Act.7:10]], al.; esp. in NT of the divine favour, grace, with emphasis on its freeness and universality: [[luke 1 30|Luk.1:30]], [[acts 14 26|Act.14:26]], [[romans 1 7|Rom.1:7]], [[1-corinthians 1 3|1Co.1:3]], al.; opposite to ὀφείλημα, [[romans 4 4|Rom.4:4, 16]]; to ἔργα, [[romans 11 6|Rom.11:6;]] (b) on the part of the receiver, a sense of favour received, thanks, gratitude: [[romans 6 17|Rom.6:17 7:25]], al.; χ. ἔχειν, to be thankful, [[luke 17 9|Luk.17:9]], [[1-timothy 1 12|1Ti.1:12]], al. 3. Objectively, of the effect of grace, (a) a state of grace: [[romans 5 2|Rom.5:2]], [[2-timothy 2 1|2Ti.2:1]], [[1-peter 5 12|1Pe.5:12]], [[2-peter 3 18|2Pe.3:18]]; (b) a proof or gift of grace (cl., a favour): [[john 1 16|Jhn.1:16]], [[acts 6 8|Act.6:8]], [[romans 1 5|Rom.1:5]], [[1-corinthians 3 10|1Co.3:10]], [[2-corinthians 9 8|2Co.9:8]], [[galatians 2 9|Gal.2:9]], [[ephesians 3 2|Eph.3:2]], [[1-peter 5 5|1Pe.5:5, 10]] al. (For fuller treatment of the NT usage, see AR, Eph., 221ff.; DB, ii, 254ff.; DCG, i, 686ff.; Cremer, see word). (AS)
